{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("First few revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
